versions.name: Docker image build and push
versions.description: Build an OCI image from a workspace context and push it to a registry. The pipeline step must mount the host Docker socket (docker-out-of-docker).
versions.description_zh: 从 workspace 构建上下文构建 OCI 镜像并推送至镜像仓库。Pipeline step 需挂载宿主 Docker socket（docker-out-of-docker）。
versions.author: buz maintainers

versions.name: Docker image build and push
versions.description: Build an OCI image from a build context inside the step directory and push it to a registry; the step's run: can follow up on the built images. Requires the docker-socket capability. Reuses the job Docker config without including credentials or the job .buz directory in the build context.
versions.description_zh: 从步骤目录内的构建上下文构建 OCI 镜像并推送至镜像仓库；步骤的 run: 可对构建出的镜像做后续处理。需要 docker-socket capability；复用 job Docker 凭据，但禁止将凭据目录或 job .buz 目录包含进构建上下文。
versions.author: buz maintainers
